title: Your bank insures $250,000. Your payment app? #Shorts
description:
The CFPB says money left in a payment app often isn't held in a bank account and lacks individual deposit insurance coverage. Over three quarters of U.S. adults have used a payment app.
Check the app's terms and consider moving idle money back to your bank.

Sources: CFPB Issue Spotlight, Analysis of Deposit Insurance Coverage on Funds Stored Through Payment Apps (1 Jun 2023, read 7 Nov 2026).
Voiceover is AI-generated. Not sponsored. Not financial advice.
